entry_points.text: Safe acquisition retries under read cover until trial hold succeeds, supporting exiting tasks; affinity creation takes capacity and returns a table.

exports.text: Task, namespace and number queries come in audit and silent forms with current and set-identity variants; monitor, filter and restore composites accept dedicated or admin and always allow.
Subsystem declaration yields controller objects or enablement keys; predicates report likely enablement for default and general cases.
Socket group alloc, clone and free are inert; namespace conversion follows container linkage; state references offer single, bulk, best-effort and live-only acquire with single and bulk release.

hazards.text: Ancestors are trailing arrays requiring the group last with depth sizing; vectors are immutable after creation with ancestor-effective states; dead groups are skipped; parents stay online via counters; serials allow resume; destruction uses work reclamation; bulk acquire needs a hold with distinct best-effort forms.

Handshake selects version 3 with lengths from type sizes. Type names allow 32 chars, hierarchy and file names 64. Weights span 1 to 10000, default 100. Count is zero without controllers with presence as nonzero. Iteration flags use bit 16 for skipped and bits 2, 1, 0 for dead-inclusive, threaded and leaders.

RDMA separates handle from object use with a count sentinel from zero. Processor values place online at 2, preparation at 3 and dead at 7. Threats order user-kernel, user-user, guest-host and guest-guest; threading offers disabled, automatic and enabled. Features report text from platform ids. Names allow 16 chars with 1 ms latency; coordination uses 0 and 2; preferences use 0 and 1.
External per-CPU helpers offer acquire, release and live best-effort acquire; namespace helpers offer increment and decrement.

invariants.text: Filesystem grouping covers ownership, node creation, access override, search, identity and MAC override; empty is none, full is all; helpers clear, set, test, combine, compare and mask-restore.

Ids stamp catalogue names into an enum ending in a count sizing arrays. State marks track uncounted, transitioning, released, visible and dying; group marks track release notice, clone and desired versus observed frozen; hierarchy options govern prefixes, attributes, delegation, migration cost and legacy modes; file marks govern visibility with global, unlocked-self and per-group attach.

Parent derives from state parent with none at root; descendant needs shared hierarchy, depth and ancestor match. Dying and online are independent; dead is offline; self is embedded equality. Task lookup fetches the set then indexes; containment tests the default group.
Group acquire and release forward to embedded state; identity delegates when enabled and collapses to one when disabled.
Without controllers attach succeeds, statistics fail invalid, fork and exit hooks are inert, init succeeds inertly and the creator blocks migration until ready.

Enabled accounting credits task counters and the default hierarchy outside root. Socket reads use single access and resolve the stored group. Frozen is per-task versus always unfrozen; namespace duplication returns its input.

Minimal setup reports zero frozen tasks, handles secondary suspend and resume, reports mitigations off with none mitigated, yields absent policies with zero readings, and treats empty online sets as inactive with a second member as shared.
Child and descendant walks invoke next helpers from absence until exhaustion in both orders; task-set walks fetch first then next with a leader-only variant.

locks.text: Linkage is safe under hierarchy mutex or RCU. Descendant tallies need either lock to read and both to update. Task lists, set links, populated counts and freezer timing use the set lock; migration and dying counts use the hierarchy mutex; statistics use base or subsystem locks with deferred teardown.
Thread-group changes hold a global per-CPU read guard plus conditional signal guard, released in reverse; hierarchy mutation uses one mutex with paired helpers.
Live walks require the hierarchy mutex and skip dead members; task fetch is allowed under scheduler read cover, hierarchy mutex, set lock or when exiting.
Policy readers hold shared cover while writers and removal hold exclusive cover; transitions add exclusive spin coordination with waiters, owner and progress flag.

state_machines.text: States move through allocation, activation, deactivation, release and destruction with reset and kill; tasks signal migrating then migrated or canceled while groups signal online then offline.
Power signals cycle unit entry, failure and exit alongside domain entry, failure and exit.

structs.text: Privilege sets wrap one 64-bit word and copy by value; filesystem records combine magic, flags, root identity and permitted plus inheritable sets.

State holds identity, anchors, reference and online counts, deferred destruction, statistics and population. Sharing groups hold immutable vectors, placement, task lists with iterators and migration endpoints with dead markers. Groups embed self state, node, hierarchy, depth and trailing ancestors with capacity, masks, vectors, accounting, events, release, pressure, filter, freezer and scheduler hooks; roots add attachment, options, agent paths and trailing root group.

File descriptors carry name, opaque word, write limit, flags, handle offset, owner, linkage, operations and lock tracking; reads use sequential rendering with open and release plus integer shortcuts; writes use integer acceptors, byte sinks and event waiting. Tables end empty, small limits promote, offsets pin handles to reachable states, sequential needs the full trio or none, and byte sinks win.

Subsystem descriptors offer lifecycle, flushing with local and extra presentation, attach validation with commit and abort, bind with fork and exit, threaded, early and implicit flags, automatic identity, file tables with dependencies, statistics locks and update lists. Implicit controllers hide yet stay enabled by default tolerating stale states; threaded relaxes granularity while implicit alone is unsupported and dependencies co-enable silently.

Sockets hold optional classification with a group pointer, empty when disabled; walkers keep set cursors, flags, subsystem, task cursor and registration; migration bundles source, destination and task.

Namespaces embed headers with user context, usage and root state. RDMA embeds state with pools and events; devices carry membership, names and indexes. Processors store affinity, hotplug and device data; affinity tables hold counts, capacity, objects and trailing destination with distance, infinity as max sixteen-bit.

Frequency metadata tracks ordering, limits with latency, creation bundles and transitions; policies aggregate masks, managers, clocks, bounds, selections, work, requests, tables, lifetime, fast-path controls, caches, coordination, statistics, private storage, thermal links and notifiers.
